title: Jammy Midnight Norwegian Rice Fried-Rice
description: A crispy and jammy Norwegian dish that's perfect for midnight cravings, featuring gochugaru and ayurvedic-rajasic-friendly ingredients. This dish is a variation of traditional Norwegian fried rice, with the addition of gochugaru and ayurvedic spices.

ingredients.name: Gochugaru
ingredients.notes: Korean chili flakes for a spicy kick

ingredients.name: Ayurvedic-rajasic-friendly rice spice blend
ingredients.notes: Available at most Indian or Ayurvedic spice markets

instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of coconut oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add the chopped onion, carrot, and celery, and cook until the vegetables are softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the gochugaru and rice spice blend, and cook for 1-2 minutes, stirring constantly.
Add the cooked rice, and stir-fry for 2-3 minutes, breaking up any clumps with a spatula.
Add the mung bean sprouts, and stir-fry for another minute.
Transfer the mixture to a serving platter, and drizzle with sesame oil.
Serve hot, garnished with additional gochugaru and sesame seeds if desired.
